source_clause: R1C1.) The comfort category will have up to 4 tabs depending on vehicle configuration. Tabs are displayed in the following order: Front, Seats (WS or R1 Low) or Seat & Wheel (Maserati), Massage, Rear. If only Front climate is available in a specific vehicle the tabs will not be displayed. Refer to separate HMI Logic and Flow documentation for Massage Seats logic.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.1（R1C1）定出 comfort category 之 tab 數、順序，以及僅前排氣候時不顯示 tab，三個 037 leaf 分別對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）；本輪只生成 -03，-01／-02 之情形見下。關鍵情境條件：-03 取 profile §3.2 第十二軸「僅前排氣候」，其 R-C28 第一問由本節明文「If only Front climate is available in a specific vehicle the tabs will not be displayed」對應，標 spec-verbatim，出處與所屬節同一故 specification_reference 僅列本節。為什麼這樣切：037 之切分為單位權威（§8.2），未合併未拆分；-01（tab 數）與 -02（順序）**不生成**，因條文只寫「depending on vehicle configuration」而未述何種配置產生何種 tab，任何具體配置之 pre_condition 皆為造值（R-C28 第一問／§8.4.1），此為內容不足而非軸不足，已登 RD-1 待答。**EMEA ICS 排除式 PC 已依 37 §1 移除**（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 判 2.1 為 no-counterpart —— ch16 十八節無 comfort category tabs 之對應節）。刻意略過：037 之 -01 寫 up to 3 tabs、-02 之順序無 Massage，而條文為 up to 4 tabs 且順序含 Massage —— 依 **R-C33** 內容以條文為準、單位以 037 為準，該落差已登 A-CF21 並列 RD-1；Massage tab 之**行為**由條文明文委派他份文件，但其**是否顯示**仍屬本節，兩者不混（§8.2.1）；**A-CF23 之逐條複查（42 §4 之名單重建）**：037 對本 leaf 之描述帶 3 張圖，`-03` 所驗者為「tab 一個都不顯示」，其判讀只需認得 tab 之有無而不需知其外觀，故**不依賴圖片所載內容** —— **惟未生成之 `-01`（tab 數）與 `-02`（順序）恰恰相反**，那兩者所缺的正是「哪一種配置產生哪一組 tab」（DATA_REQUESTS #17），而圖片極可能載之，故該二 leaf 解封時須先讀圖。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: head unit 之 comfort category 與其 tabs
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 補（6.3 移除 comfort section）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 本節即該軸之來源節，PC 已正向帶之
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **ch16 無對應節（no-counterpart，`ch16_mirror_map.tsv`）** —— ch16 十八節無 soft top rear defrost 之對應節。EMEA 排除式 PC 與 16.2 引用已依 37 §1 移除

tcs.tc_title: No tabs are displayed when only Front climate is available
tcs.test_item:
If only Front climate is available in a specific vehicle the tabs will not be displayed.

(read the comfort category for tabs -> No tabs are displayed)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] Only Front climate is available in the vehicle (2.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the comfort category
2. Read the comfort category for tabs
tcs.expected_result:
1. The comfort category is displayed
2. No tabs are displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: If only Front climate is available in a specific vehicle, the tabs shall not be displayed

tcs.tc_title: Four tabs are displayed when the vehicle has all four comfort areas
tcs.test_item:
R1C1.) The comfort category will have up to 4 tabs depending on vehicle configuration.

(count the tabs displayed -> Four tabs are displayed and no further tab is displayed)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is configured with all four of the comfort areas the clause lists — Front, Seats, Massage and Rear (2.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the comfort category
2. Count the tabs displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The comfort category is displayed
2. Four tabs are displayed and no further tab is displayed
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.split_reason: §8.3 之邊界軸（=limit）：條文之上界為 4 個 tab，本條取該上界，同 leaf 之另二條分取 limit−1 與其內部值，而 =0 之邊界已由 `001-03` 承載。
tcs.test_item_authored: The comfort category shall have up to 4 tabs depending on vehicle configuration

tcs.tc_title: Three tabs are displayed when the vehicle has three comfort areas
tcs.test_item:
R1C1.) The comfort category will have up to 4 tabs depending on vehicle configuration.

(count and read the tabs displayed -> Three tabs are displayed and each of them is one of Front, Seats, Massage and Rear)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is configured with three of the four comfort areas the clause lists — Front, Seats, Massage and Rear (2.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the comfort category
2. Count and read the tabs displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The comfort category is displayed
2. Three tabs are displayed and each of them is one of Front, Seats, Massage and Rear
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.split_reason: §8.3 之邊界軸（limit−1）：上界為 4，本條取其下一值。
tcs.test_item_authored: The comfort category shall have up to 4 tabs depending on vehicle configuration

tcs.tc_title: Comfort tabs are displayed in the order the clause gives
tcs.test_item:
Tabs are displayed in the following order: Front, Seats (WS or R1 Low) or Seat & Wheel (Maserati), Massage, Rear.

(read the tabs from left to right -> The tabs read Front, Seats, Massage and Rear in that order)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is configured with all four of the comfort areas the clause lists — Front, Seats, Massage and Rear (2.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the comfort category
2. Read the tabs from left to right
tcs.expected_result:
1. The comfort category is displayed
2. The tabs read Front, Seats, Massage and Rear in that order
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: The tabs shall be displayed in the order Front, Seats, Massage, Rear
